comment: Copy to config/civ6ai.local.json (gitignored) or override via env. reasoning is on|off only — never send reasoning_effort=on to LM Studio. Env overrides: CIV6AI_MODEL_PROVIDER, LMSTUDIO_BASE_URL, LMSTUDIO_MODEL, LMSTUDIO_API_KEY, CIV6AI_LMSTUDIO_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, CIV6AI_LMSTUDIO_VISION, CIV6AI_LMSTUDIO_REASONING, CIV6AI_CONTEXT_BUDGET, CIV6AI_QUEUE_SHARED_MODEL, CIV6AI_MP_MOVE_SYNC.
